name: Bat Cave Road Farm
description: A family-owned farm in Old Fort, NC offering a petting zoo, seasonal farmstand, and thrift shop.

hours.general: Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Mondays.
hours.petting_zoo: Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Mondays.
hours.farmstand: Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Mondays.
hours.thrift_shop: Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Mondays.

services.name: Petting Zoo
services.description: Interactive petting zoo with goats, pigs, white peacocks, donkey, ducklings, sheep, rabbits, and chickens. Appointments recommended. Call (828) 216-5488.

services.name: Farm Stand
services.description: Seasonal fresh produce, sourdough bread, pastries, farm eggs, local honey, homemade jams, pickles, and cut flowers.

services.name: Thrift Shop
services.description: Vintage kitchenware, antiques, collectibles, books, furniture, and one-of-a-kind finds. Donations accepted.
